title: Payment Authorization
description: The system shall authorize customer payments through the configured payment gateway before confirming an order.

title: Payment Failure Notification
description: The system shall notify the customer when a payment transaction fails.

title: Duplicate Payment Prevention
description: The system shall prevent duplicate payment processing when the same transaction request is submitted multiple times.

title: Payment Retry
description: The system shall allow eligible failed payment transactions to be retried.

title: Order Confirmation
description: The system shall create an order only after successful payment authorization.

title: Transaction Status Tracking
description: The system shall maintain the current status of each payment transaction.

title: Refund Processing
description: The system shall support full and partial refunds for eligible transactions.

title: Fraud Validation
description: The system shall perform fraud-risk validation before completing high-risk payment transactions.

title: Customer Receipt
description: The system shall generate a digital receipt after successful order completion.

title: Payment Audit Trail
description: The system shall maintain an auditable history of payment status changes.

title: Failed Transaction Reporting
description: The system shall provide reporting for failed payment transactions and failure reasons.

title: Customer Payment History
description: Authorized users shall be able to view a customer's historical payment transactions.

title: Refund Notification
description: The system shall notify customers when a refund is initiated or completed.

title: Payment Failure Communication
description: The customer must receive a notification after payment failure.

title: Transaction Search
description: Authorized business users shall be able to search transactions using order ID, customer ID, transaction ID, and date range.
